user.title: Use the Tuya or Smart Life app
user.description: This integration reuses Home Assistant's official Tuya app login. No Tuya developer subscription is required.

select_device.title: Select Lock Device
select_device.description: Choose a lock from the official Tuya integration. Device Sharing control is confirmed for the documented target model and experimental for other locks. Every command must be physically confirmed by the lock.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Tuya Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: Update the Tuya IoT Platform credentials for {name}. The configured lock will not change.

reconfigure_confirm.title: Switch to free Tuya app authentication
reconfigure_confirm.description: Switch {name} from developer cloud credentials to Home Assistant's official Tuya app session. Existing entity identities will be preserved.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Check your Access ID and Access Secret on iot.tuya.com.
error.service_not_authorized: Tuya Cloud services are not authorized. In your Tuya IoT project, authorize both IoT Core and Smart Lock Open Service, then try again.
error.rate_limited: Tuya Cloud rate limit reached. Wait a few minutes and retry.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Tuya Cloud API. Check your network and region.
error.remote_unlock_disabled: Remote unlock is not enabled on this device. Enable it in the Tuya or Smart Life app first.

abort.already_using_official_tuya: This lock already uses the official Tuya app session.
abort.migration_device_not_found: The same lock was not found in the official Tuya integration. Reload the official integration and try again.
abort.no_devices_found: No supported locks were found in the official Tuya integration. Confirm the lock appears in the Tuya or Smart Life app, then reload the official integration.
abort.official_tuya_reauth_started: Reauthentication was started for the official Tuya integration.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The lock now uses free Tuya app authentication.
abort.reauth_successful: Tuya Cloud credentials were updated successfully.
abort.tuya_not_configured: Set up and load Home Assistant's official Tuya integration with the Tuya or Smart Life app before adding this integration.

command_authentication_failed.message: Tuya Cloud authentication failed. Reauthentication has been requested.

command_not_authorized.message: Tuya Cloud is not authorized to operate this lock.

command_rate_limited.message: Tuya Cloud is temporarily rate limited. Try again later.

command_device_unavailable.message: The Tuya smart lock is offline or unavailable.

command_rejected.message: Tuya rejected the smart lock command.

command_connection_failed.message: Unable to communicate with Tuya Cloud.

command_confirmation_timeout.message: Tuya accepted the lock command but the physical state was not confirmed.
